text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...The swelling in your leg is concerning.
Why don't you take a break for a little while?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
We've done a general check on everything else, too,
and there don't seem to be any major problems.
Well, we just need to keep an eye on things.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz!*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, 40 LANE notifications...!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Dad and Mom are sending way too many messages...
choice_data_list: I was just that worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. I guess that makes sense.
Your daughter being rushed to the hospital right after the Derby,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since her family had come to cheer her on at the Derby, they have already been contacted about the situation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained to her family that it wasn't anything serious
and took over looking after her, but...
they must have been worried the entire time.
choice_data_list: How about heading home next time you get some time off?
How about visiting home next time you take a break?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, yeah, you're right.
It might be more reassuring to show our faces in person.
choice_data_list: You should head home and do the big-sister thing for a change.
Why don't you go home and be a big sister for a change?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Totally! Resting your legs sounds like it'd get super boring with nothing to do~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And in the meantime, Trainer,
you think up the training for our next goal, the "Kikuka Sho"!
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I submitted a leave request
and decided to let her rest at her family home for about a week.”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you'd better not eat anything weird
just because I'm not around, okay?
choice_data_list: I won't eat it, I swear!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, really~?
Then I'm off-nano!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I watched until the train
carrying Ines Fujin departed from the station.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I returned to the trainer's office,
the room that had been cluttered with Derby materials
until recently was now tidy and clean.
choice_data_list: …I wonder if Aines cleaned up for me

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I think things over on my cleared-off desk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho, is a 3,000-meter stamina contest. If Ines Fujin challenges it—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"...There is a concern
that her body might not be able to hold out."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: "...Indeed. How she looked after the Derby had the Academy staff worried as well."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: More support will surely be needed. Her physical condition is one thing, but I'm especially worried about her mental balance.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When you push your body too hard,
your mind begins to fray as well.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over her even more attentively
than ever before, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
I'm home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A week flew by in no time.
After an examination at the hospital, there seemed to be no issue with resuming training, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I have something reaaally important to tell you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she arrived at the gym,
she leaned forward and broke the silence.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey. For my upcoming races,
can I aim for a more efficient running style?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Um, you know how...
I completely passed out after the Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to make sure this doesn't happen next time.
...I want to avoid getting exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Like... blazing a brand new trail for my running!
What do you think!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she approached me with
was an opportunity I couldn't have even dreamed of asking for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some Umamusume have an extremely hard time changing their familiar running style.
Because of that, you must be prepared for a long battle, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it can lessen the burden on her body,
we should definitely give it a try.
choice_data_list: Sounds great! Let's try it at the training camp too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah!
Please take care of updating the menu too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
With this, even more.
If my body can move whenever I want it to...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Boss.
There's something I'd like to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ines, what's up~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Summer training camp season is just around the corner.
I need to come up with new training for her before then.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is the Kikuka Sho.
